title: Implement lora_recv_async in LICHEN LoRa drivers (prereq for L2 async RX)
description: Bead sb0b's premise 'driver async API already exists' is false: lr1110.c:627, lora_sim.c:433, lora_renode.c:279 all return -ENOTSUP, and lora_loopback.c (ping_l2 RX source) has no recv_async vtable slot at all (NULL fp call). Wiring lichen L2 to lora_recv_async without this work makes every driver deaf - a hardware RX regression (rx_thread polling works today on LR1110). Implement recv_async: LR1110 DIO1 RX_DONE IRQ + RX-continuous re-arm per SX126x/LR1110 datasheet; loopback driver delivers queued packets via registered cb (work-item context); sim/renode at minimum must not silently -ENOTSUP once L2 depends on it. Discovered from sb0b during claim check.
acceptance_criteria: lora_recv_async on each driver delivers frames (loopback: ping_l2 RX path; lr1110: DIO1 IRQ path per datasheet); L2 async tests pass; no NULL recv_async vtable slots remain
close_reason: Implemented lora_recv_async on all four drivers (loopback, sim, renode, lr1110). Loopback: work-item delivery of queued packets; sim: dedicated RX thread speaking the push protocol (RX_ENTER/RX_PACKET/RX_TIMEOUT_PUSH, same as lichen-hal/lichen-embassy Rust clients) with thread-owned modem release; renode: self-rescheduling 10ms delayable-work poller; lr1110: DIO9 IRQ path re-enabled while armed with RX-continuous re-arm per datasheet, fail-stop disarm on SPI failure. All four use upstream sx12xx semantics: CAS modem lock, -EBUSY on conflict, cancel via cb=NULL (-EINVAL if idle). Fixed 3-review findings: failed-acquire counter leak (atomic_cas), sim cancel/recv-thread socket cross-consumption (thread releases modem on park, self-disarm after 10 consecutive exchange failures), lr1110 NULL-cb race (cb_lock + single snapshot), lr1110 rearm storm (fail-stop), drain_exact signed-length regression, renode mid-run cancel race (cancel_delayable_sync + pre-register re-check), loopback sync-recv steal (-EBUSY when armed), unbounded drain cap, k_thread_create under spinlock, sim stack default 4096. Validated on AWS Zephyr v3.7.0 builder (worktree 1m92-validate): loopback+sim compile native_sim/native/64, renode compiles nucleo_wl55jc, lr1110 compiles t1000_e/nrf52840; new ztest test_loopback_recv_async_delivers_frames passes (arm, -EBUSY double-arm, delivery with correct len/RSSI/SNR, cancel 0, -EINVAL double cancel); full hal suite passes both configs; cppcheck clean. Pre-existing (not this bead): coap_status.c static-assert/switch-enum failures break puck app + ping_l2 builds against v3.7.0 - filed separately.
